# Villa Azure Hotel

> Villa Azure is a 16-suite boutique beachfront hotel in Ocean Park, San Juan, Puerto Rico. One property: sixteen designer suites (many with ocean views) sleeping up to 38 guests, two pools, direct beach access, an in-house private chef and personalized concierge. Ideal for large groups, wedding events and full-hotel buyouts. Book direct with no OTA fees.

## Key Facts

- Location: 5 Calle Guerrero Noble, San Juan, 00913, Puerto Rico (Ocean Park, steps from Ocean Park Beach, minutes from Condado and Old San Juan)
- Accommodations: 16 en-suite designer suites, king and queen configurations, sleeps up to 38 guests
- Amenities: two private pools, direct beach access, in-house private chef, concierge, BBQ terrace, chef's kitchens, free WiFi, free parking
- Events: oceanfront weddings and corporate retreats with full-hotel buyouts (ceremony gardens, oceanfront terraces, coastal dining room)
- Experiences: in-suite spa treatments, private beach and garden yoga (retreat-friendly), in-suite massage, and kitesurfing at Ocean Park Beach, one of Puerto Rico's best-known kite spots
- Booking: https://villaazurehotel.guestybookings.com/en (direct, no OTA fees)
- Contact: info@villaazurehotelpr.com · +1 (954) 900-1988
- Languages: English and Spanish (https://villaazurehotelpr.com/es/)
